title: Krazy's No-Hit Challenge Datapack
description: A simple Datapack for 1.21.10+ that will make all damage lethal to the player.
body:
A simple datapack that causes all damage to be lethal!

Shields are still able to block hits, but Golden Apples, Resistance or Totems will do nothing to save you. 

Any and all damage will cause you to die. Best experienced in Hardcore mode to make for a fully damage-less Minecraft challenge! How far can you get without taking damage?

This Datapack is designed for version 1.21.10. However I do plan on creating updates for older versions if people like it!

_Pack created by Krazycarrotman!_
